Trapped between Jethalal and Sodhi who both put down token money for the flat, Bhide calls Chandiramani. Hearing that two buyers are competing, Chandiramani announces he is flying down to Mumbai to hold an open society auction on Sunday to get the highest price.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
